summary: Independent read-only re-review of the two previous findings and the fresh-capture guard passed. Nonblocking encoder stdin and concurrent bounded stderr draining enforce one deadline through stalled writes, unbuffered close and encoder completion; failure paths kill/reap the child, preserve diagnostics and retain the previous preview. Report preflight rejects existing files, source/output descendants and symlink/hardlink aliases before encoding; exclusive publication prevents overwrite. Capture output reuse is rejected before game initialization. All 69 focused CPU regression tests passed using the repository .venv and scratch basetemp; git diff --check passed. System python3 lacked pytest, so the installed repository environment was used without installation. No repository files edited, commits, Blender, GL, main or full-suite runs; only scratch pytest artifacts and this verdict were created.
